payload.title: Report sending volume to Prospectus quota: percent only, no dollars
payload.description:
**Milestone:** Later, coarse

**Goal.** If Ryan confirms sending counts toward quota. Register with `quota: true` in Prospectus (Prospectus session told before merge). Report item kinds such as `caducus.email.sent` by Account via `POST /v1/quota/accounts/{account}/usage`, batched, retried with the same operation id. No rates in this public repo; customers see percent used. Operator, last-resort and consent mail never check quota.

**Acceptance.**
An unknown kind's 422 is visible; no dollar figure or rate anywhere in Git.

**Depends on:** kanbus-b47fad
